pages.text: Create Ore Excavation hides ore veins underground. You locate a vein, put a Drilling Machine on it, and it produces raw ore as long as it has rotation. Veins here are finite and run out.

pages.title: Ore Vein Finder
pages.text: Right-click to scan. It reports what is in your chunk, nearby, or just traces further away.

pages.title: Drilling Machine
pages.text: Needs rotation and a Drill (Iron, Diamond or Netherite). Output depends on the vein, including bonus items by chance.

pages.title: Sample Drill
pages.text: Pins down a vein's exact details into an Ore Vein Atlas. The Atlas also filters the Vein Finder to a chosen vein.

The Deposits add-on supplies the vein list: coal, copper, iron, zinc, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond, emerald, quartz and glowstone, plus Nether gold, Nether quartz and ancient debris veins. Check the Atlas or JEI.

pages.title: Fluid Well Extractor
pages.text: Pulls fluid from a vein instead of items. Deposits include an Underground Spring that yields water.

Veins give raw ore, so crushing and washing still apply: $(l:create_basics/crushing)Crushing$(/l) and $(l:materials/ore_guide)Ore Guide$(/l). Drills need $(l:create_basics/stress)stress$(/l). Lead and TFMG ores are not in the vein list.
